metadata.concurrency_mechanism: Firestore Distributed Lease Lock + Atomic Mutex Transaction

scenarios_evaluated.outcome: Exactly 1 enrollment transaction succeeds; 2nd request fails closed with HTTP 409 Conflict ('Another enrollment session is currently in progress').
Stale lock expired (>60s); second request safely acquires lease and executes cleanly.
Subsequent retry within active session window detected as duplicate in-progress request.
